page.overview:
Who is Guthan Archi?

Guthan Archi was human male child lived as a street urchin on the planet Olega during the High Republic Era. Archi stole a rock from the cart of the scrap merchant Anbert Dregil and hurled it at the Olega Jedi temple's door. A gatekeeper droid told him to stop playing pranks and to leave. While he distracted the droid, a veiled Mae-ho Aniseya threw a magnetic restraining bolt onto the gatekeeper droid which hijacked the droid, causing the gate to open. Aniseya then gave him a token before entered the Olega temple.

The next day, the urchin was captured by the Jedi Cord Taunus and Od Keder presented Archi to a group of Jedi investigating the break-in. He explained that the gatekeeper droids caught the child loitering around their portcullis. Padawan Jecki Lon then spoke with the child and asks if he had activated the security droid. The child nodded and explained that someone paid him to do it. When Lon asked who it was, he mistakenly pointed to Mae-ho's twin, Verosha Aniseya, who was accompanying the Jedi.
